result.Method of Attack: Typosquatting to mimic legitimate Python packages; Delivery of Remote Access Trojan (SilentSync) with sophisticated payload hiding; Supply chain attack exploiting trust in open-source repositories; Social engineering by mimicking functionality and appearance of legitimate packages
result.Attack Vector: Installation of typosquatted malicious packages from PyPI; Execution of malicious code via package initialization functions
Indicators of Compromise: Property list file com.apple.pyhelper.plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents (macOS persistence)
Hardcoded Base64 encoded C2 server IP 200.58.107.25
Use of TCP port 5000 with REST API endpoints for command-and-control
Download of malicious script from https://pastebin.com/raw/jaH2uRE1
Targeting Chromium-based browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave) and Firefox for data exfiltration (history, autofill, cookies, credentials)
